title: Volck Zeolite Carbon Fiber Foldable Bike
body_html:
Volck Zeolite Carbon Fiber Foldable Bike
The modern and sleek frame of the Volck Zeolite folding bike is a sight to behold. Coupled with high performance components, the Volck Zeolite comes with everything in a foldable package.

Unique features
Equipped with 9-speed adjustment SHIMANO SORA R3000 shifter level and derailleur system, and the SHIMANO MT200 hydraulic brake – the Volck Zeolite boasts both performance and safety. It also comes with adjustable seat posts, giving riders the flexibility of adjusting it to their comfort. Foldability is what makes the Zeolite shine with an amazing folded size of 35" x 27" x 17" and a featherweight of 22lbs!

Wheels
Running on CST 20″ * 1.75″ C-1576 (27 TPI) tyres, the Volck Zeolite foldable bicycle is no stranger when it comes to conquering distance and terrain. The 20″ wheels ensure that the bicycle is able to cover long distances and achieve higher speeds with less effort.

Frame
Manufactured from TORAY Carbon Fiber Frame from Japan, durable and lightweight – ideal for a performance-centric bicycle. The bicycle frame is crucial with not only holding up the weight of the rider but it also influences the overall control and maneuverability of the bicycle as a whole.

Brakes
Besides its strong carbon fiber frame, the bicycle also comes with Shimano MT200 hydraulic brakes. Shimano MT200 brakes are known for their soft and precise braking. It makes braking more efficient and safe even when the bicycle is going downhill.

Volck is the sister company of SAVA that’s reputable in the bicycle industry. Volck is mainly known for their carbon fibre frames and premium components used on all their bicycles. They usually use high-end brands like Shimano and their frames are manufactured in Germany. If you’re looking for a quality bicycle with premium components, Volck is a brand for you!                  

               

         20"                  22lbs

title: Volck Slate Carbon Fiber Roadbike
body_html:
Volck Slate Carbon Fiber Roadbike
The Volck Slate Carbon Fiber road bike comes at an entry-level price with a professional feel of a tour level road bike. The Japanese Toray T700 light and durable carbon fiber frame, high quality Shimano as well as Tektro components. The overall quality of the bicycle makes it the perfect road bike for starters in the market.

Unique features
Equipped with drop bars for optimum aerodynamic cycling. The Volck Slate is equipped with 18 Speeds SHIMANO SORA R3000 Groupset that ensures a smooth start when cycling and seamless speed shifting throughout the journey. The engineering behind the road bike takes into consideration the importance of aerodynamics, the bike adopts a wind tunnel design where the stays, seat post, and seat tube are aerodynamically contoured.

Wheels
Running on Michelin 25-622 (700C*25C) Dynamic Sport tires which is ideal for roads, control, achieving speed and stability.

Frame
The fork, frame, and seat post are all manufactured from Japanese Toray T700 carbon fiber to ensure light weight and durability. The bicycle weighs only 21lbs.

Brakes
The Volck Slate is equipped with P400DG Tektro V braking system.

Volck is the sister company of SAVA that’s reputable in the bicycle industry. Volck is mainly known for their carbon fibre frames and premium components used on all their bicycles. title: Weped GTR
body_html:
Weped GTR is a one-of-a-kind, ultra-fast electric scooter with super aggressive looks and best-in-class features. The e-scooter is the front runner in the hyperscooter category, owing to its insane performance, beyond impressive range, and high-class ride quality.

Powered by 50A dual hub motors capable of producing a colossal output of 3000W each. The highly potent motor enables the electric scooter to carry a maximum load of 300 lbs, and its 35-degree hill-climbing ability outperforms many other scooters in this class.

The Weped GTR is the “King of Speed” as it can reach a scintillating top speed of 65 MPH in a flash. The e-scooter enthusiasts will surely cherish such blazing speeds as they effortlessly zip through the crowded city streets.

With one of the largest battery packs of any scooter on the market, the Weped GTR is a range anxiety killer. The e-scooter is equipped with a high-capacity, top-grade 2700Wh 60V, 45Ah, 21700 Samsung battery that provides up to 70 miles of range on a single charge.

An optimal braking system is essential for the rapid deceleration of any high-performance electric scooter. That’s why the Weped GTR is equipped with cutting-edge hydraulic brakes that instantly bring it to a complete halt. A regenerative braking system is also added that recovers the lost energy as the rider apply the brakes.

NOTE: Front column LED garnish is not included, Additional of $350 (MSRP $450) is required for add-on.

                             

  6000w              65mph          60V, 45aH              

                            

50-70 miles        300 lbs                  35°

title: Vsett 11+
body_html:
The VSETT 11+ takes electric scooters to a whole new level with an insane range up to 75 miles and speeds over 50 MPH, making it one of the most advanced scooters on the market today.

With a giant 60V 31.2Ah Li-ion battery the VSETT 11+ boasts a 75 mile maximum range in single motor mode.

The new VSETT Control Throttle Display is packed with features. Tune your ride your way. Protect your ride with the NFC Key Lock Immobilizer which ensures only you can start your VSETT. Use the DDM button to switch from Eco to Sport mode. And when you need more, use the Turbo Boost for a short burst of extra power.

VSETT 11+ touts aggressive styling and features a bright head light and taillights, flashing brake lights, integrated turn signal lights and a colorful RGB logo on the deck side.

The Dualtron Thunder 2 has everything that made the success of the Thunder and in addition to that, everything it lacked and made it “imperfect”.

title: Dualtron Storm
body_html:
Pure riding and pure adrenaline, Minimotors is proud to introduce Dualtron ‘Storm’, a substantial and bold evolution of Dualtron ‘Thunder’; and as the name suggests, is extremely robust and strong, making it the most high-tech, high-performance and uncompromising electric scooter ever. For unconditional sheer riding pleasure that lasts as long as the road ahead. The mere sight of the iconic design causes adrenaline levels to rise.

Significant technological improvements on the motors, braking system, and frame design push the physical boundaries and the limits of riding dynamics once again further. More radical, more aggressive, and more dramatic, the Dualtron ‘Storm’ is Minimotors’s pinnacle of riding dynamics, enabling straightforward handling on winding roads and providing an impelling thrill behind the wheels.

Inspiring, fascinating, and ready to reinterpret mobility. The Dualtron ‘Storm’ was designed and made by Minimotors HQs after collecting thousands of feedback worldwide from the exceptional Dualtron ‘Thunder’. The idea behind the Dualtron Storm is simple: to give our customers an all-in-one featured scooter that is powerful, sturdy, well designed, smart, and aggressive. It is future-proofed given its extreme performance.

The Dualtron Storm is equipped with two state-of-the-art Minimotors’ Direct Drive Brushless (HUB) motors that deliver a total power of 6640W, enough to take you to unbelievable speeds that exceed 62 mph. The immense torque combined with a relatively low curb weight of 101 lbs means that the ‘Storm’ can go as fast as 62 mph, much quicker than its predecessor. To top things off, it also comes fitted with a huge battery pack of 72V 31.5Ah, powered by LG, which enables the ‘Storm’ to travel 80 miles* with ease.

Equipped with 11-inch Ultra-Wide tubeless tires, and enhanced water-resistance throughout its body, Dualtron ‘Storm’ is the perfect electric scooter built for off-road, cross-country use. It boasts its ability to climb almost any hills with a slope of 70% (around 35°). The ‘Storm’ dares to claim itself the “King of Mountains”.

                             

  6,640w              62mph          72V, 31.5aH              

                            

75 miles              330 lbs                  35°                

         

     11"                 101 lbs

Warranty valid for 6-months, read our warranty policy here.

Click here to find out more about Dualtron Storm!

title: Gemini Titan 2500 OLED Headlight
body_html:
All New 2020 Gemini Series

The Titan 2500 OLED is the most powerful bike light we've ever made. The Titan's design ethos was inspired by endurance desert racing – to pack power in a minimalist profile. A low and wide footprint optimizes airflow over the aluminum chassis enabling for rapid cooling. With so much power available on tap, it's hard to grasp why you'd need anything more than this.

Powering the Titan 2500 OLED is a brand new 60Wh 4-Cell Battery achieving 2 hours of runtime at maximum power. 

The Titan 2500 OLED features a high contrast OLED display that provides live runtime remaining, battery information, and light modes.

  • 2500 Lumens
  • 60Wh 4-Cell Battery
  • Wireless Remote
  • OLED Display

title: Magura MT7e (Pair)
body_html:
MT7e – Maximum braking performance for any road conditions

The MT7e brakes everything… even the motor!

Specially developed for e-bikes, the MT7e has an integrated switch for motor-cut and brake lights.

The 4-piston brake calliper forged in one piece has a high degree of rigidity, resulting in outstanding braking force and the best possible modulation. The high braking force of 4 pistons and its fine modulation make the MT7e a sure-footed companion. We guarantee that.

MAGURA have come up with a groundbreaking new solution for the MT7e: a mechanical switch located right inside the brake lever. It activates the brake light even before the brakes actually bite, and this will also be useful for power assist systems with a regenerative braking mode, so that it can be engaged as quickly as possible.

Brakeset comes in a pair with free installation, Rotor Spacers & External Banjo are included only with installation in-store. (Rotor Spacer & External Banjo are not included with Brakes Only purchase)

Brake Rotors each sold separately. Installation is limited to in-store only at an additional labor fee of $70 per motor.

Installation fee of $200 per brakeset and $100 per rotors purchased from external sources. Rotor Spacers & External Banjo when required, will be at an additional of $160.

  • Material: Carbotecture, Flip-Flop-Design
  • 4-Finger, Aluminium with switch
  • Royal Blood (mineral oil based)
  • 550gm

title: Dualtron Ultra II
body_html:
Ultra II, the successor of the legendary off-road electric scooter from Minimotors. This all-new 2020 Dualtron Ultra II takes the performance even further with an upgraded 72v 35AH LG MJ1 battery (2520Wh). 

The new 72v controllers that were designed from the ground up are relocated to the rear “wing” that allows better heat management and water-resistant. This will allows the rider to enjoy more torque and higher top speed without overheating the controllers. 

The Ultra II has now equipped with a highly efficient and adjustable suspension suitable for all-terrains.

In addition, the Ultra II also inherited all the LED lighting features from the Dualtron Thunder providing more visibility, making it a safer ride in the night.

Great for anyone who weighs up to 200 lbs, I would recommend this scooter as an easy-going device, real slim, real stable and which 99% of the time you will not need more power of more range than what this beast already has.

It comes equipped with EYE Throttle with Cruise Control, Mileage, Voltage, Auto Shut-Off, Eco-Drive, Dual Drive, Turbo Drive, Adjustable Motor Power Delivery, Adjustable Electric Brake Force, On and Off ABS Safety Breaking Feature.

It comes equipped with dual side LED Lights for super-visibility and really impressive light show for those warm summer evenings

title: Cygolite Hotrod 120
body_html: Packed in a sleek profile that complements your road bike, the Hotrod 120™ unleashes a powerful 120 lumens of radiant wide coverage. Its 6 attention grabbing modes keep motorists aware of your presence any time you’re on the road. Its Versatite™ flexible mount lets you attach the Hotrod 120™ tail light to most seat posts and seat stays, including aero styles.

title: Cygolite Hotshot Pro 200
body_html:
The most powerful line of single LED tail lights just got even brighter. Sporting an aggressive design and powerful output, the Hotshot Pro™ 200 is engineered from the ground up to stand out in the brightest of daytime and at night with intense 200 lumen flashes. Exclusive 2 button design lets you fully adjust the tempo of each flash mode to maximize motorist awareness. It even senses day and night, automatically adjusting the brightness of the flashing modes.

Every bit the road cyclist's tail light, its extra wide beam lens maximizes your presence from afar, and its new low profile flexible mount makes it easy to use on standard and aero seat posts. Get the most out of your ride with up to 210 hours of run time. (patent pending)

title: Niterider Omega 300
body_html:
The Niterider Omega 300 rear bike light allows you to be seen day or night by projecting a whopping 300 lumens of bright light. It features 5 modes (2 flashing and 2 constant) as well as a group ride mode that allows you to be seen without distracting fellow cyclists. The convenient USB charger allows you to charge your light while you’re at work. The Omega meets FL1 and IP64 standards for dust and water resistance. An easy on and off seat post strap mount with quick release allows to easily remove the light while it’s not in use.

FEATURES

  • Daylight Visible Flash allows you to be seen even in the daylight hours.
  • Dust and water resistant for all weather use.
  • USB rechargeable for convenient charging.
  • Group ride mode be seen without distracting fellow cyclists.

title: Sram Avid HS-1 160mm Rotors
body_html:
Great technology can change the way you ride, and with the Avid HS1 Heat Shedding Rotor you'll be riding longer than ever. With a new cross-drilled design, the HS1 holds true to its name by efficiently shedding heat. It allows you to tackle the technical by riding the brakes to your heart's content without fear of overheating. More control, less weight, and minimal wear -- that's our kind of rotor.The Avid HS1 Heat Shedding Rotor is the next step in disc brake technology. The one-piece stainless steel design utilizes cross-drilled technology (think Merckx-era drillium) for significant weight savings without compromising durability. The new design promotes heat regulation, and weighs around ten grams less than previous models. The cross-drilling also sheds water quickly, resulting in increased stopping power in wet weather.

 

Installation not included. Installation Fee is $100/rotor. Rotor Spacer may be required for installation. Rotor space sold separately at $80 a pair. Installation is limited to in-store only.

title: Gemini Titan 4000 OLED Headlight
body_html:
All New 2020 Gemini Series

The Titan 4000 OLED is the most powerful bike light we've ever made. The Titan's design ethos was inspired by endurance desert racing – to pack power in a minimalist profile. A low and wide footprint optimizes airflow over the aluminum chassis enabling for rapid cooling. With so much power available on tap, it's hard to grasp why you'd need anything more than this.

Powering the Titan 4000 OLED is a brand new 60Wh 4-Cell Battery achieving 2 hours of runtime at maximum power. 

The Titan 4000 OLED features a high contrast OLED display that provides live runtime remaining, battery information, and light modes.

  • 4000 Lumens
  • 60Wh 4-Cell Battery
  • Wireless Remote
  • OLED Display

title: Magura Brake Pads for MT5/MT5e/MT7
body_html:
Magura's 8-series disc brake pads feature a disconnected back plate, letting them compress independently of each other

8.P pads are replacement pads for Magura's MT5 and MT7 series 4-piston brake systems. An independent steel support plate holds the organic pad, built with a high performance stopping compound.

8.R pads utilize their unique race compound, offering maximum stopping power for riders who want to push the limits.

9.C pads for ultimate comfort. For riders who want control rather than bite from their brakes as well as those looking for a long-lasting product.

9.P pads for Performance. For long tours these pads offer safety together with excellent performance in all situations.

 

Installation not included. Installation Fee is $20/side. Installation is limited to in-store only.

title: Gemini Duo 2200 Multisport Headlight
body_html:
Small. Light. Powerful.

The Duo 2200 Multisport was designed to be your primary go-to light for all headlamp needs. The versatile mounting system allows you to adapt the Duo 2200 to virtually any sport, hence why we call it Multisport.

There is also a GoPro Multisport Adapter that allows for the Duo 2200 Multisport to attach to GoPro's vast array of mounting options and styles.

Powering the Duo 2200 OLED is a brand new 30Wh 2-Cell Battery achieving 2 hours of runtime at maximum power.

  • 2200 Lumens
  • Built-in Handlebar Mount
  • Helmet Mount and Head Strap
  • Wireless Remote

title: Magura MT5e (Pair)
body_html:
MT5e – Maximum braking performance for any road conditions

The MT5e brakes everything… even the motor!

Specially developed for e-bikes, the MT5e has an integrated switch for motor-cut and brake lights.

The 4-piston brake calliper forged in one piece has a high degree of rigidity, resulting in outstanding braking force and the best possible modulation. The high braking force of 4 pistons and its fine modulation make the MT5e a sure-footed companion. We guarantee that.

Brakeset comes in a pair with free installation, Rotor Spacers & External Banjo are included only with installation in-store. (Rotor Spacer & External Banjo are not included with Brakes Only purchase)

Brake Rotors each sold separately. Installation is limited to in-store only at an additional labor fee of $70 per motor.

Installation fee of $200 per brakeset and $100 per rotors purchased from external sources. Rotor Spacers & External Banjo when required, will be at an additional of $160.

  • Material: Carbotecture, Flip-Flop-Design
  • 4-Finger, Aluminium with switch
  • Royal Blood (mineral oil based)
  • 550gm
